summary.headline: Venus, Mercury, and Moon Ages
summary.text: Continuation of a cosmological astrological account of the fifth through seventh millennia and zones ruled by Venus, Mercury, and the Moon, describing human longevity, planetary periods, Venusian vices, Mercury’s influence on Hermetic sciences, and lunar proximity to Earth. The apparatus compares readings in manuscripts V and N and cites the Mutinensis epitome and Mon. Myst. de Mithra.
